BETA Close X Mears Group PLC has executed a share buyback programme, purchasing a total of 157,519 ordinary shares between July 8th and July 10th, 2026. The weighted average purchase price for these shares was approximately 425.79 pence, with prices ranging from 413.00 pence to 430.00 pence. Since the program's inception on April 1st, 2026, Mears has acquired 3,165,722 shares for cancellation.
